name: SIFT
summary: A granular recorder that takes language apart. Daisy Bell plays whole; tilt it and syllables stammer, swap and drop out until only dust is left. Also a map of grains by sound.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Holds 20 s of sound in PSRAM. Loads the Samplooler's saved slots as material.
status_note: 0.2 flashed on 2026-10-22: it starts and keeps up (CPU 17 %, 19 % torn to dust with feedback; 107 KB internal RAM free). Not played much yet.
